sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Flow cytometry confirmed cell-surface display of the HA-tagged α6 subunit; total and surface expression both measured. No electrophysiological or ligand-binding functional assay reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states that FLAG or HA epitopes were inserted between mature aa 4 and 5 of GABRA6 (and other α subunits) in full-length membrane-anchored constructs. With the signal peptide spanning canonical residues 1–19, mature aa 4 maps to canonical residue 23 (V) and mature aa 5 to canonical residue 24 (E), computed by adding the 19-residue SP offset. The junction at canonical 23/24 lies 4 residues from the mature N-terminus and 219 residues from TM1 (canonical 242), well within the large extracellular N-terminal domain (canonical 20–241). L2 (same paper) independently confirms surface display of α6^HA by flow cytometry, corroborating L1. FLAG (DYKDDDDK) or HA (YPYDVPDYA) epitopes inserted between amino acids 4 and 5 of the mature GABRA6 subunit in full-length, membrane-anchored constructs expressed in HEK293T cells. The signal peptide spans canonical residues 1–19, so mature aa 4 = canonical residue 23 (V) and mature aa 5 = canonical residue 24 (E); the tag sits between them. α6^HA was co-transfected with β2, β3, and FLAG-tagged γ2 subunits and surface expression was confirmed by flow cytometry.

sources.claim: FLAG (DYKDDDDK) or HA (YPYDVPDYA) epitopes were inserted between amino acids 4 and 5 of the mature GABA A receptor subunit subtypes as needed, so that subunit total and cell surface expression could be determined by flow cytometry.

literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1 and L2) derive from the same publication (PMC5021343) and together establish one site. L1 is the primary evidence pinning the insertion to mature aa 4/5; L2 confirms surface expression of the α6^HA construct specifically. The position is computed: signal peptide = canonical 1–19, so mature residue n = canonical residue n+19; mature aa 4 → canonical 23 (V), mature aa 5 → canonical 24 (E). No functional electrophysiology or ligand-binding data are reported in the clips, so validation_level is surface_only. No other ledger lines support additional sites. The large intracellular loop (canonical 325–419) and the short extracellular loops (291–301, 442–453) have no ledger support for insertions and are not proposed.
